item.title: New poll shows 45% of US voters identify as independents, shifting away from major political parties
item.description: A growing share of Americans are distancing themselves from both major political parties, a trend that's reshaping the electoral landscape nationally and in California. A new Gallup survey found that 45% of U.S. adults now identify as political independents, the highest level recorded in Gallup's three decades of tracking voter affiliation.
